scripts.build: npm run generate:contracts && npm run sync:director-contract && tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build && node scripts/prepare-sites-build.mjs
scripts.build:performance: npm run sync:director-contract && tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build --config performance.vite.config.ts
scripts.build:extension: npm run generate:contracts && npm run sync:director-contract && tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build --config extension.vite.config.ts && vite build --config extension-content.vite.config.ts && npm run verify:extension-csp
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:performance && npm run build:extension
scripts.ci: npm run test:coverage && npm run typecheck && npm run build:all && npm run test:gateway && npm run verify:release-status && npm run verify:bundle-budgets && npm run verify:module-budgets
